notes: Printer Bot 3.0.11 prints the Imgur links viewers copy from the Imgur site. The page of one picture (imgur.com/<name>) prints that picture, and an album or post (imgur.com/a/<id>, imgur.com/gallery/<id>) prints its first picture only, never the rest. For an album, Printer Bot asks imgur.com which picture comes first before the receipt prints (at most 3 seconds); an album with no picture prints [image], and one that starts with a video stays text. As before, only in a High Roller message, with Imgur switched on and Allow images on. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.0.11 on GitHub.
